Chapter 6044: Such A Decline

Chapter 6044: Such A Decline

“Five-element Mountain’s members had joined Ancient Society before. It can be traced back to Fire Ancestor, Zither Empress, or even the three immortals.”

“The three immortals.” Six-style became emotional after hearing about these legendary existences who were the targets of Immortals Slaughtered War.

None in their world was older than the three immortals. History stopped with them.

“Fire Ancestor, that’s a forbidden and ominous name.” Kundali murmured.

“There’s nothing to it, just a tale unknown by the present day.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Looks like you already know everything, Young Noble. I can’t give you more information.” Kundali sighed.

“You can tell me about their target.” Li Qiye said.

“In theory, it was someone who wasn’t born yet, Moshi’s reincarnation who later was known as Dingtian.” Kundali answered.

“The legend of Zhan Sansheng, from Moshi to Dingtian and then Poye.” Six-style became emotional after gaining more proof of this widely accepted legend.

“Yes, Zhan Sansheng should be real.” Kundali was confident in this - all of these beings were the same person.

“Something’s off.” Li Qiye shook his head: “Where did they get their information from? This is the greatest of secrets, Zhan Sansheng wouldn’t have told anyone. If others knew, it was a deliberate leak.”

“I believe you are correct, Young Noble.” Kundali nodded: “I do not know how the battle went, but one thing is for certain, I believe the coalition was wiped out. The progenitors were never heard from or seen again afterward.”

“The reincarnated Dingtian killed all of them?” Six-style asked.

“Then the war would be public, not a secret.” Li Qiye answered.

“That makes sense.” Six-style agreed because Dingtian’s brilliance and battle feats were known to all.

“Then the target has to be someone else.” Kundali said.

“If it were possible to stop the reincarnation, the ones from the Redemption Grounds would have done it long ago.” Li Qiye said.

The duo thought about it and agreed. A newly reincarnated Zhan Sansheng would have been at his weakest and most vulnerable.

Since his enemies included mythical immortals, they would have tried to kill him in the cradle, preventing future wars.

“Then who is the target…” Kundali murmured.

“Perhaps the yet-to-be-born Dingtian was indeed their original goal, but something changed during the plan.” Li Qiye said.

“Right, perhaps they changed the target.” Kundali said.

“Would these progenitors change their target after all the planning to deal with Dingtian?” Li Qiye smiled.

“I suppose not.” Kundali agreed with Li Qiye.

“It doesn’t sound right either, but nothing else makes sense.” Six-style thought these brilliant progenitors would not change course that easily.

“I don’t think we will know the answer. People either don’t know or won’t reveal it, this includes those in Life and Death Heaven and Supreme Heaven.” Kundali shook his head.

“It was a misdirection, the target they locked onto was wrong from the start.” Li Qiye said: “That’s why they were uncertain and started Old Pact. They lived long enough to know that it might be a mistake but still wanted to try. After all, not all of them could live forever.”

“I see, that’s the reason why only old progenitors were involved in this battle. Perhaps the mythical immortals knew of this as well.” Kundali said.

“It wouldn’t have been necessary if they had a perfect grasp on the location of reincarnation.” Li Qiye said.

The duo agreed because with accurate information, the so-called immortals, Desolate Ancestor, First Vine, and many others would have joined as well to kill Dingtian. The uncertainty stopped them from doing so.

“What else do you know?” Li Qiye asked.

“They teamed up to create an incredible weapon made from the core of Silver Dragon Mecha. This was their ace card.” Kundali said.

“It went missing afterward.” Li Qiye stroked his chin.

“Yes, that’s as far as I know.” Kundali said.

“Let’s take a look at the battlefield, where is it?” Li Qiye said.

“Well…” Kundali hesitated and said: “Young Noble, I have made a promise, it’s quite a predicament for me.”

“Don’t worry, I don’t need you to take me.” Li Qiye waved his hand.

“Thank you, Young Noble.” Kundali bowed and said: “As for the location, I only have some clues. Perhaps you will be able to find it.”

“Go on.” Li Qiye said.

“Please head to Five-element City.” Kundali said: “Take the badge and find the descendants of Five-element Mountain, they will be able to take you to the right place.”

“Descendants of Five-element Mountain?” Li Qiye had a smirk on his face as he repeated.

Kundali had a forced smile before letting out a sigh: “Such a decline.”
